title: Mianloong Chamber (Quest)
html:
Mianloong Chamber

Quest Type

Main

Chapter

Chapter I: Act VII - Thaw of Eons

Description

According to the Sentinel's hints, three Flare Stones must be activated, and the Flare Crests be put out to remove the chains on them that are made of special Flare Crests.
Previous Quest Next Quest
Road of Pilgrimage The Commander of Time
  • Characters
Jinhsi, Jué, Rover
Mianloong Chamber is the seventh act in Chapter I of the Main Quests.

Contents

  • 1 Steps
  • 2 Dialogue
  • 3 Other Languages
  • 4 Change History
  • 5 Navigation

Steps[]

  1. Inspect the hibernation pod
  2. Operate the Chronosorter to adjust the water level
  3. Approach and activate the Flare Stone to put out the Flare Crest (Part One)
  4. Approach and activate the Flare Stone to put out the Flare Crest (Part Two)
  5. Check the file
  6. Operate the Chronosorter
  7. Levitate the Tacetite Fulminate
  8. Use the Tacetite Fulminate to destroy the Fissured Ledge
  9. Approach and activate the Flare Stone to put out the Flare Crest (Part Two)
  10. Use the Tacetite Fulminate to destroy the Fissured Ledge
  11. Approach and activate the Flare Stone to put out the Flare Crest (Part Three)
  12. Return to Mianloong Chamber and inspect the hibernation pod

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
According to the Sentinel's hints, three Flare Stones must be activated, and the Flare Crests be put out to remove the chains on them that are made of special Flare Crests.
Jinhsi: The Flare Crest...
Jinhsi: The Sentinel is telling us... We need to find the three Flare Stones corresponding to the Flare Crest, then we will be able to lift the confinement set by the Fractsidus.
Rover: But I'm not seeing any Flare Stones. Or any kind of entrance to another chamber.
Jinhsi: There seems to be something underwater. Let's start with the Chronosorter here.
(If player switched the timeline via the Chronosorter to the middle)
Rover: The water level has dropped.
Rover: It's the Flare Stone. On that rock!
Jinhsi: Let's go retrieve it.
(If player switched the timeline via the Chronosorter to the left)
Rover: The water level has dropped.
Rover: It's the Flare Stone. On that rock!
Jinhsi: Let's go retrieve it.
(After player activates the first Flare Stone)
Rover: Done.
Jinhsi: Two more to go. Let's look for them nearby.
(When player checks the file)
(Cutscene plays)
Jinhsi & Narrator: ...Once Tacet Discords terrorized the land. The region of Jinzhou was under siege.
Narrator: A mother and her newborn child were hiding in ruins, trying to avoid the deadly creatures
Narrator: They weren't safe for long as the Tacet Discords found them. The mother sacrificed herself to protect her child
Narrator: ...but with her gone, it was difficult for the newborn to survive. In a couple minutes, its loud cries gradually died out
Narrator: Fortunately, the newborn's cries echoed through the forest, with a unique resonance that reached the ears of the mighty Sentinel
Narrator: With a burst of energy, our Sentinel dispelled the surrounding evils
Narrator: But sadly, it was too late
Narrator: That night, Mt. Firmament shook with the roars of a Loong, and dark clouds gathered. The Sentinel returned with a dead infant in its embrace
Narrator: As if by magic, somber clouds parted and shooting stars lit up the sky. With Mt. Firmament's unique flow of time, the Sentinel brought the deceased infant back to life
Jinhsi & Narrator: The resurrected infant became known as the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator, and went on to become the Magistrate of Jinzhou...
(Cutscene ends)
Jinhsi: ...
The "deceased infant" here, is it...
Jinhsi: Yes... It's me.
Jinhsi: I've lived in Jinzhou my whole life and never ventured into Hongzhen, yet even I know of the legend.
Jinhsi: To me, Jué is more than just our Sentinel or a revered divine being... It raised me and saved me from certain death.
Jinhsi: I've been thinking about it on our way here.
Jinhsi: If the Sentinel predicted our fight, why would it even bother saving me in the first place?
Jinhsi: Now I understand why. Because I am the Sentinel's Resonator. I may not have any extraordinary abilities, but I do possess the Temporal Program that it accidentally lost.
Jinhsi: If Jinzhou ever faces a similar time crisis, I... I might be the only one who can set things right.
Jinhsi: ...In our Sentinel's prediction, the battle between us is supposed to happen in the distant future.
Jinhsi: It had been waiting for an opportunity, a right moment to tell me the truth. That's why it didn't explain.
Jinhsi: Now may not be the opportunity the Sentinel has been waiting for, but my body cannot hold up much longer...
Jinhsi: I have to go and face it while I still can... to learn about the truth, or complete our destined battle.
You can still give up.
As your friend, I don't want to see you suffer.
Jinhsi: Give up... my duty? I never thought about it...
Jinhsi: To be honest... I did doubt myself many times.
Jinhsi: It was the endless kindness of you, Changli, Xinyi, and everyone in Jinzhou that gave me the courage to push on.
Jinhsi: Even Jué's decision to bring me back to life... Whether out of pity or not, I am truly grateful. The thought of it warms my heart every time.
Jinhsi: Jinzhou holds everything that's dear to me. Even without the title of Magistrate, I could never leave Jinzhou behind.
But your wounds...
Jinhsi: I'm okay...
Jinhsi: The pain I'm feeling is nothing compared to those trapped in the Temporal Disruptions.
Jinhsi: I must find the Sentinel as soon as possible. We draw from the same source of power—saving it means saving myself.
Do you have to fight the Sentinel?
Jinhsi: If there is truly no other option in the end...
Jinhsi: Then I will have to fight it. I refuse to back down.
Jinhsi: I will fight. To protect the Sentinel, and to defend Jinzhou. One life may be lost, but many will be saved.
Jinhsi: If it means keeping everyone safe, then I have no regrets giving my own life.
Jinhsi: But let me make one thing clear—I am not planning on dying yet. I am here to fight for a chance at survival, no matter how slim that chance may be.
Jinhsi: We're not in a situation where death is our only option, are we?
I trust your decision.
I will help you.
Jinhsi: Thank you for placing your trust in me.
Jinhsi: Come to think of it, many good things have happened to me since you arrived in Jinzhou.
Jinhsi: Thank you, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
I am always here for you.
I'll make sure you turn out safe.
I'll go meet the Sentinel with you.
Jinhsi: My teacher Changli told me it's up to both of us to solve the crisis at Mt. Firmament. As I know you have a special connection with our Sentinel, I need your support in this decision.
Jinhsi: But don't worry, I'm prepared. This isn't about succumbing to destiny, it's about embracing it fully.
Jinhsi: I am grateful to have you by my side through it all.
(After player activates the second Flare Stone)
Rover: One last Flare Stone to go.
(When player approaches the Fissured Ledge)
Rover: The remaining Photonvault is hidden behind the Fissured Ledge.
Jinhsi: Fissured Ledge... If only there was a Tacetite Fulminate...
Jinhsi: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), let's look around.
(When player approaches the third Flare Stone inside the barrier)
Rover: The Flare Stone is right here, but we have to open this Photon Barrier first.
Jinhsi: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), this barrier will break down once the corresponding Photonvaults are destroyed.
Jinhsi: ...One of the Photonvaults is in there.
(If player hasn't shot the Photonvaults connected to the Corroder's barrier)
Jinhsi: We need to find a way to destroy the Spikes with the Corroder's help... Same as last time, let's locate the Photonvault first.
(After putting out the barrier)
Jinhsi: Good. Now we can work that Flare Stone.
(After activating the third Flare Stone)
Rover: All set. The Sentinel should be able to break free now.
Jinhsi: ...Yes, I believe so.
Jinhsi: Let's head back to the Sentinel's place.
(Cutscene plays)
(Cutscene ends)
"Jué": Jinhsi, it has been quite some time.
"Jué": And greetings, (‍‍LordText for male Rover‍/‍LadyText for female Rover‍‍) Arbiter. Or should one address you as "Rover" now?
"Jué": One cannot discern the cause of your arrival, yet its significance heralds Jinzhou's fateful juncture.
"Jué": Shall a "child" who has lost their memories take up arms and fight for their fate? Or shall they retreat to their cradle and slumber?
"Jué": The seed of the future shall be sown in this very moment.
What do you mean by "Arbiter"? What should I do?
I don't understand. Care to explain again?
"Jué": Once the situation settles, an explanation shall be provided. For now, one must implore you to simply engage, decide, and observe.
"Jué": Jinhsi, your journey has been an arduous one. Aside from aiding one in this predicament, surely there are other inquiries you wish to make?
Jinhsi: I cannot bring myself to ask for more. All I seek is the truth.
Jinhsi: Mt. Firmament is in grave danger... Regarding the Temporal Mandate and your injuries... Please, do not keep the truth from me any longer.
"Jué": One understands your concerns. The timing may not be optimal for this disclosure, yet in the midst of crisis, one must act with expedience.
"Jué": For one will soon perish.
Jinhsi: ...
"Jué": One such as this, of immortal nature, is designed to endure for all time.
"Jué": Yet one suffered severe harm in ancient times, and now relies on the Mianloong Chamber for survival.
"Jué": This is not the optimal solution.
"Jué": For a long time, one has had to use this chamber to replenish energy, hoping to delay the inevitable doom.
"Jué": Yet fate cannot be defied. The Fractsidus have conspired against this one. Now, the injury only worsens... The Mianloong Chamber can no longer prolong one's life.
If you die, what will happen to Jinzhou?
"Jué": Jinzhou... The city of Jinzhou will be no more.
Jinhsi: ...
"Jué": Ever since one descended upon Mt. Firmament, using the power of Temporal Mandate to repel Tacet Discords, time has been in disarray within this location. The fate of Jinzhou was sealed from that moment on.
"Jué": Over the past millenia, one has defied the laws of nature and sustained Jinzhou at the cost of one's own life force.
"Jué": Otherwise, the Temporal Disruption would wreak havoc not only on Mt. Firmament, but on the entire region of Jinzhou. If this were to happen, all life will be engulfed in a chaotic storm of twisted time flow.
What would happen to them?
"Jué": Jinzhou shall forever remain frozen in time. The past and the future meld into one, rendering life indistinguishable from death. The ceremonial rituals and endless battles persist, intertwining joy and sorrow into an eternal blur.
"Jué": All inhabitants of Jinzhou shall endure this perpetual fate until time itself ceases to exist.
"Jué": ...It is this one's own doing, and one must put an end to it.
"Jué": In the coming days, one will exert every ounce of strength to freeze the time in Jinzhou at the cost of one's remaining life.
"Jué": In that moment, Jinzhou will fall into stillness, but not perish. In the distant future, the people of Huanglong may discover a method to rescue Jinzhou.
Jinhsi: Is there truly nothing else we can do?
"Jué": This is not the optimal solution, but it suffices as an option.
Jinhsi: Please forgive me... but I cannot do as you say.
Jinhsi: A decade, a century... What if nobody comes up with a solution? By that time, the world will have turned its back on this forgotten city...
Jinhsi: ...And who would be willing to spend precious resources rescuing a small city in a far-off corner of the world?
Jinhsi: Jinzhou's fate deserves better than an uncertain future.
"Jué": Whilst one may not live to witness the future, one can still envision endless possibilities yet to come. In my deduction, this method proves to be the most effective and stable.
"Jué": Magistrate Jinhsi, as you express doubts, pray tell how do you propose to solve this issue?
"Jué": The flow of time upon Mt. Firmament is in disarray, and it can only be contained through one's utmost effort.
"Jué": If one does not freeze the time now, the situation in Jinzhou shall surely worsen a hundredfold, or even a thousandfold, after one's passing.
Jinhsi: ..You once predicted a destined battle between us... Is it true?
"Jué": Correct.
Jinhsi: ...I was lost at first, struggling to grasp the prophecy's meaning. Only when I learned of your actions alongside the Court of Savantae did it all become clear—
Jinhsi: By clashing two resonating powers, a Second Resonance Awakening can be induced. Through this, I am able to push my Resonance Ability beyond its limits and invoke the Temporal Mandate to restore the flow of time.
Jinhsi: ...Though I will be forced to raise my blade against you...
"Jué": RIDICULOUS!
"Jué": If you clash with my resonance power, even the smallest mistake will result in Overclocking and leave you nothing but an empty husk.
"Jué": You are well aware of its excruciating effects. The pain you feel now is but a faint scratch in comparison to its true torment.
"Jué": Moreover, you will be trapped within the fissures of time itself. Your being will be relentlessly shredded and mended, day after day, denied any respite for eternity.
Jinhsi: But I can restore the errors in the flow of time. Isn't that why you saved me all those years ago? I'm just doing what you've been doing all along... Going against fate to keep Jinzhou safe.
"Jué": Jinhsi, you are given one last opportunity. Let me freeze the time, and I can ensure your safety.
There must be another way.
What if I help her? I am here for a reason.
Is there really no chance for her to live?
"Jué": You are only here to witness before the right time arrives.
"Jué": But you are not compelled to remain idle. Should you intervene, we may augment Jinhsi's odds of survival by a fraction.
"Jué": Command me to transfer my Temporal Mandate access to Jinhsi at the right moment.
"Jué": —The moment of her Resonance Ability's depletion, when she is teetering on the brink of Overclocking and near death. Then, we may still save her life.
"Jué": Miss that moment by even the slightest margin, and Jinhsi's fate will be sealed.
I will do everything I can to keep Jinhsi safe.
So a fight between you two is unavoidable.
(Cutscene plays)
Jinhsi: ...I should have died a long time ago... but I was lucky enough to be saved by you, allowing me the chance to see the glittering lights of Jinzhou for myself.
Jinhsi: ...You rewinded time to save me. I am responsible.
Jinhsi: Jinzhou is my home. If it's ever in danger, I will do everything in my power to protect what I hold dear, even at the cost of my own life.
"Jué": Such a valiant speech!
"Jué": Do you know the weight of this decision?
Jinhsi: I understand your concerns. I will reach my Second Awakening with our destined confrontation, and restore the time flow.
Jinhsi: Are you willing to bet on me?
"Jué": Restore the time flow? Pray, from where does this confidence arise?
"Jué": You are my Resonator, but your strength is only a fraction of mine.
"Jué": There is little chance for you to retreat unscathed.
Jinhsi: But I can at least win some hope for our people!
Jinhsi: Even if it costs me my soul, my everything... I cannot die without trying.
Jinhsi: I may only bear your power for a fleeting moment... It's all I need to secure a better future for Jinzhou, defying all of your predictions. And I can keep you safe.
Jinhsi: If there is anyone who can face you in a fight...That person has to be your Resonator.
Jinhsi: I will be your final winning move in this game.
"Jué": HAHAHAHAHA!
"Jué": Are you truly ready to challenge a being worshipped by your kind? Will you not regret it when you meet your bitter demise?
Jinhsi: I will not regret it, no matter what.
"Jué": Very well! Magistrate of Jinzhou!
"Jué": Come to the summit. Demonstrate your prowess!
"Jué": Show me how you shall be my triumphant ace.
(Cutscene ends)
